assessments.reasoning: The retained project rationale identifies dynamic language design as the effort, general-purpose use as its aim, the JVM as its chosen platform and Lisp as its lineage. These are the project’s descriptions at the enrolled revision.

challenge.method: Check whether the JVM is merely an example of customer infrastructure and whether Lisp is merely an unrelated comparison.
challenge.results: The project explicitly ties its own design to both the JVM and Lisp. The rationale supports the scoped language identity and supplies no basis for merging other hosted language identities or assigning catalog lifecycle status.

limitations: Active is the catalog lifecycle state for the language identity.
